name: Radley
long_description:
Radley is the first AI-native radiology practice. We're acquiring a radiology practice bringing Radley to $4.6M in annualized revenue and rebuilding it with agents from the ground up.

Radiology is already in crisis: there aren't enough radiologists to interpret 1 in 6 medical scans. In 10 years, that gap is growing to 1 in 3 - 246M scans a year.

From past experience, we know that point solutions won’t cut it. While there is demand (we have $2.2M in contracts to prove it), bottleneck isn't just software, it's outdated systems and slow, inefficient operations. That's why we own the full stack, clinical and operational, end to end.

We met at Carbon Health as we scaled operations 31x and expanded to 100+ clinics. Now we're rebuilding radiology.

launches.title: Radley:  We're building the first full stack, AI-native radiology practice
launches.tagline: We're redesigning the entire radiology operation to be AI-native from the ground up, unlocking scan capacity without adding radiologists.
launches.body:
**TL;DR: We're Corgi for Radiology. The first AI-native full stack radiology practice. We’re acquiring a radiology practice bringing us to $4.6M in annualized revenue.** 

**Problem.** Radiology is already in crisis. The US needs 20% more radiologists to meet demand, and in 10 years that gap will reach 50% - 246M scans the workforce can’t handle. Agents can finally do most workflows. The industry is not moving fast enough to adopt it. 

**How we started.** Radiology is flooded with AI hype. We started riding that wave. But after digging into how these practices actually run, and drawing on our time scaling Carbon Health to 100+ sites, one thing became obvious: selling a dozen AI point-solutions and rolling them out department by department is too slow, and only adds incremental value. Building the whole practice in a AI-native way from day one is what’s needed. It solves the radiologist shortage directly instead of one contract at a time. This shift grew our market **21x**.

Same insight Corgi had in insurance: don't sell software to the incumbent, become the AI-native incumbent.

So now we’re building the entire radiology workflow and business operations AI native and adding capacity without headcount. 

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vgHtRDCB22Q>

**Traction:**

* **$4.6M annualized revenue**

**Why us.** We met at Carbon Health as we scaled operations 31x and expanded to 100+ clinics. Now we're rebuilding radiology.

**Our ask. Reach out if:**

* You’re a **radiologist** who wants to work at and shape an AI-native practice
* You can help connect us with an independent or hospital owned **imaging centers** struggling to keep up with radiology demand 
* Anyone who's building in **AI-native services**, we'd love to compare notes

Reach us at [founders@radley.health](mailto:founders@radley.health).
